subject: Security add-ons pricing — audit logs & KMS/HSM surcharge for HealthPay
messages:
From: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@healthpay.com>
To: aisha.ra@redwood.ai <aisha.ra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthpay.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: compliance add-ons pricing (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking a look. We're finalizing our vendor shortlist and I need a clear breakdown of Redwood's pricing for the compliance/security add-ons. Specifically: audit log retention beyond the default (30/90/365 days), KMS/HSM options and per-key pricing, data residency options (US-only vs multi-region), and any HIPAA bundle pricing or surcharges.

We also need to understand discount levers for an annual commitment and whether onboarding fees or migration assistance are included for Enterprise plans. Do you have a one-page outline or a quote you can share?

We'd like to get initial numbers by EOD Wednesday so procurement can prepare an RFP response.

Thanks,
Emma Jensen
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthPay

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jensen <emma.jensen@healthpay.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask: compliance add-ons pricing (audit logs, KMS/HSM, residency, HIPAA)

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Quick answers up front: we have modular pricing for audit logs and residency, KMS/HSM is available as a managed add-on (per-key + monthly), and we offer a HIPAA-compliant bundle for customers that need it.

I'm attaching a concise pricing workbook that shows list and committed rates, plus a few example configurations for Health/Fin workloads. Can you confirm: (1) target retention (90 vs 365) for logs, (2) expected monthly throughput (average tokens/day) so we can size storage and egress, and (3) whether you require key custody in your HSM or are ok with Redwood-managed KMS with BYOK support?

If it helps, we can also sketch a mutual action plan and an optional discount ladder — typically 10–25% on add-ons with an annual commit and multi-year contract. I'll loop Sean for commercial and Marissa for compliance specifics.

Attachment: redwood_compliance_pricing_v3.xlsx (pricing workbook, 6 sheets)

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HealthPay pricing ask — draft quote included

Sean — forwarding HealthPay's ask. Attached is the pricing workbook with three bundles: 1) "Baseline" (audit logs 90d, Redwood-managed KMS), 2) "Compliance" (audit logs 365d, BYOK + per-key HSM option), 3) "HIPAA Bundle" (Compliance + SOC2 evidence, dedicated residency + higher SLA).

Notes inside the sheet: HSM provisioning lead time is ~6 weeks for dedicated HSM and there is a one-time provisioning fee (listed). For commercial, Emma requested sample committed pricing by Wed EOD. I'm thinking we offer: 15% off add-ons with a 12-month $X commit, or 22% with a 24-month commit. Also propose to waive the one-time provisioning fee for any 24-month HIPAA bundle. Thoughts?

Quoted message below.

Aisha — looks good. A couple of guardrails from commercial:

- Recommend we standardize the discount ladder in the sheet: 12-mo commit = 15% off add-ons, 24-mo = 22%, 36+ = 28%.
- For HIPAA customers we should keep base pricing visible but present the final price as a bundled figure (includes SOC2 evidence, residency, 24/7 support). For HealthPay specifically: propose a one-time onboarding credit of $5k if they sign by July 10.
- HSM: confirm whether we show Redwood-managed HSM (cheaper) vs customer-managed HSM (higher per-key + HW fee). Include lead times and a refundable deposit for dedicated HSM hardware.

I'll let Marissa confirm compliance constraints (especially around BYOK and attestations). Once they confirm target retention and throughput we can finalize a HubSpot quote and send DocuSign.

-Sean
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthPay pricing ask — compliance notes

Team — quick compliance callouts for the quote:

- BYOK: HealthPay will need an SOC2 appendix covering key custody responsibilities. We can support BYOK with HSM-backed keys but only in specific regions at GA. For now, US East and US West have HSM HA; EU availability is planned Q4.
- Audit logs: 365-day retention requires encrypted, WORM storage and a different ingestion SLA (we bill storage + retrieval). Put the default retention and a per-GB/month delta line in the workbook.
- HIPAA Bundle: include a clause for BAAs and an annual Data Processing Addendum. Also list the SOC2 artifact delivery cadence (quarterly review + on-demand evidence with 5 business days).

Attachments to reference: SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (we should attach when sending the HIPAA bundle), and a short MPA template for BYOK responsibilities.

Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
